transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what's been bothering you or what brings you in today?

Um... hi. I guess... I've just been having some thoughts lately that kind of scare me. I keep catching myself thinking that maybe it would just be easier if I didn't wake up. And... sometimes on my drive home, I just wonder if my family, or my students... if they'd just be better off without me. I don't want to actually do anything, I really don't. But... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Have you noticed that you don't enjoy things as much as you used to, or that you've lost interest in activities you used to find pleasurable?

Yeah... I guess so. I used to have things I looked forward to. Like, um... softball, or my book club. Even just working in my garden, or helping with the robotics club at school. But... lately, I mostly just go through the motions if I do go. Or I just cancel. It just... none of it really feels enjoyable anymore.
Have you been feeling like you're not worth much or that you're a burden to others lately?

I guess... yeah. Um... like at work, if a lesson goes badly, or even if a student just looks confused... I don't know, I just keep replaying it in my head. It feels like proof that I'm letting everyone down. Like I'm just... a terrible teacher. And a terrible mother, too. I just... yeah.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently? Like, have you been eating more or less than usual, or gained or lost weight without trying?

Um... I guess I've been eating less. During the school day, I just... I don't really think about it. I usually don't eat anything until I get home in the afternoon. And... my clothes don't really fit right anymore. They're pretty loose. I haven't been trying to lose weight or anything, it just... happened.
Have you noticed that you're moving more slowly than usual, or that your thoughts feel slowed down?
I don't think so. I haven't really noticed anything like that.
Have you been feeling more tired or fatigued lately, even if you're not doing anything physically demanding?

Yeah... I guess so. Um... by the time I get through teaching and... like, a department meeting... my body just feels really heavy. I don't know. Even just... making dinner or answering a few parent emails... it just feels like climbing a hill.
Do you find yourself feeling guilty or like you're failing others almost every day?

Um... yeah. I guess so. Just... if a lesson goes badly at school, or... if a student just looks confused... I don't know. I just take it as proof that I'm letting everyone down. I kind of just... keep replaying it in my head. It just makes me feel like I'm a terrible teacher... and... a terrible mother, I guess.
How long have you been feeling this way? Have these feelings been going on for most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks?

Um... yeah, definitely longer than two weeks. I guess... it's been going on for about a year and seven months now. That's... that's when I took over the STEM assessment redesign... on top of my regular teaching load. So... yeah. Pretty much every day since then.
Have you noticed yourself fidgeting, pacing, or feeling restless lately, or on the other hand, moving or talking more slowly than usual?
Um... no. I haven't really noticed anything like that. I just... I move normally, I think.
Have you had periods like this before, where you felt down or lost interest in things, or is this the first time you've felt this way?
Um... no. I don't... I don't think so. Just... just this time, really.
Have you ever felt this way before, like you were struggling with your mood or losing interest in things, even if it wasn't this severe or didn't last this long?
Um... no. Like I said... I really don't think so. I mean... everyone gets stressed sometimes, but... nothing like this. It's just been since last year.
Before this current period, have you ever had any other times in your life when you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks?
No. I... I'm sure I haven't. I don't remember ever feeling like this for that long before. It's really just been this one time.
Before this current period, have you ever had any episodes where you felt down or lost interest in things for more than a couple of weeks?
I... I feel like you keep asking me the same thing. No. I haven't. It's... it's just been this one time.
In the past, have you ever had a period where you felt down or lost interest in things, and then fully recovered for a while—like at least a couple of months—before another episode happened?
No... I don't know how else to say it. There wasn't another time before this. So... no, I didn't have anything to recover from.
Before this current period, have you ever experienced a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks, even if it wasn’t as bad as this?
I... no. I really don't have a different answer for you. Even if it wasn't as bad, it's still no. Just... just this time.
